meta.title: Typography torture deck
meta.author: Scaena

states.name: Variable axes

case.text: 01 · Variable axes: wght, wdth, opsz · kill

states.notes: Pass: each pair differs only on its axis. wght 100 vs 900 changes stroke weight; wdth 50 vs 150 changes set width; opsz 8 vs 144 at the same 64 cu size changes contrast and spacing (gate 0 criterion 2: opsz and wdth demonstrably change glyph shapes).

states.name: Standard ligatures
states.notes: Pass: the top line uses the ffi, ffl, fj and fl ligature glyphs; the bottom line (liga off) shows the same letters unjoined. Same font, same size.

states.name: Discretionary ligatures
states.notes: Catalogue: EB Garamond with dlig on (top) forms Th, st, ct, tt, ch, ck and ft ligatures; the control line below has dlig off.

states.name: Kerning
states.notes: Pass: AV, To, LT, Wa and Yo close up in the top line (GPOS kern, -55 to -75 units/em in Roboto Serif) and sit loose in the bottom line with kern off.

states.name: Numeral styles
states.notes: Pass: in the tabular lines 1111 and 0000 are the same width; in the proportional lines 1111 is narrower. Oldstyle lines have ascending and descending figures (3, 4, 5, 7, 9 drop below the baseline); lining lines do not.

states.name: Accented Latin
states.notes: Pass: every precomposed letter renders from Roboto Serif (no fallback, no .notdef), with accents correctly placed on capitals and lowercase.

states.name: Combining marks
states.notes: Catalogue: decomposed sequences (NFD) shape to the same appearance as precomposed letters; stacked marks (ế, ệ) do not collide; marks on bases with no precomposed form (q̃, x́) are positioned by GPOS mark attachment.

states.name: Punctuation
states.notes: Recorded: curly quotes, em and en dashes and the ellipsis come from the font (no straight-quote or three-period substitutes). The opening “ of the first line hangs outside the text edge, like every quote that opens a line (SPEC §3.5).

states.name: Mixed weights and sizes

case.text: 09 · Mixed weights and sizes in one line · kill

states.notes: Pass: one line, five runs, one shared baseline; weights 100/400/900 at 56 cu, then 112 cu and 28 cu runs. Line height follows the tallest run.

states.name: Tracking extremes
states.notes: Pass: the top line is set 0.08 em tighter than default (letters nearly touching, none overlapping on this face); the bottom line is spaced 0.40 em. Tracking adds after every glyph; it must not break ligature or kerning shaping.

states.name: Hanging punctuation and optical margins

case.text: 11 · Hanging quotes · kill; optical margins · recorded

states.notes: Pass: every quotation mark that opens a line hangs outside the text edge, so the letter after it sits on the edge: the “ of line 1 and the ‘ of line 3, at x = −(quote advance). Line 1 fits the measure only because its quote is not counted (985 cu inside 998; 1009 with the quote). With optical margins, the V of line 2 and the W of line 5 start 5% of their advance left of the edge. The comma and period at line ends do not hang: the right edge is ragged, and nothing hangs at a ragged edge (SPEC §3.5).

states.name: Balanced headline
states.notes: Pass: two lines of similar length (e.g. "Revenue doubled while the / product mix shifted"). Greedy breaking at this width gives 1642 cu + 521 cu; balance must fix that.

states.name: Pretty paragraph, bait widow

case.text: 13 · Pretty paragraph with a bait widow · kill

states.notes: Pass: the last line carries at least two words (role minLastLineWords: 2). Bare greedy breaking (minLastLineWords: 1) at this width strands "mistake." alone on line 3, robustly (±15 cu of measurement drift still strands it).

states.name: Unbreakable word

case.text: 14 · Wrap: one long unbreakable word · recorded

states.notes: Recorded: the compound is wider than its 852 cu box. Record what happens: overflow (E100), emergency break, or clip. Nothing may draw outside the box silently.

states.name: URL
states.notes: Recorded: a URL wider than its box. Record where it breaks (after / ? & # are acceptable break points) and whether any break happens inside a path segment.

states.name: Narrow measure
states.notes: Recorded: a 268 cu column at 32 cu. Expect ragged short lines; record raggedness and any overflow.

states.name: Emoji

case.text: 17 · Emoji: COLRv1, ZWJ, skin tone, flag · catalogue

states.notes: Catalogue: color glyphs from Noto Color Emoji (COLRv1 only; the SVG table is stripped). The ZWJ sequence and the skin tone form one glyph; VS16 is invisible. Trap: EB Garamond, earlier in the fallback chain, maps the regional indicator letters, so per-codepoint fallback draws 🇺🇸 as two monochrome Garamond letters. Fallback must be per cluster and honour default emoji presentation (UTS #51): one color flag.

states.name: Bidi: Hebrew

case.text: 18 · Bidi: Hebrew with inline Latin · catalogue

states.notes: Catalogue: right-to-left paragraph; "Scaena" and "0.1" stay left-to-right inside it; the final period sits at the left end. Glyphs from Noto Sans Hebrew (its own Latin).

states.name: Bidi: Arabic

case.text: 19 · Bidi: Arabic with inline Latin · catalogue

states.notes: Catalogue: right-to-left with joined Arabic letterforms (initial/medial/final shapes) and the lam-alef ligature in الإصدار; Latin and digits stay left-to-right.

states.name: Bundle-internal fallback

case.text: 20 · Fallback within one run: 3 fonts · kill

states.notes: Pass: a single run in Roboto Serif. α and ω (absent from Roboto Serif) fall back to EB Garamond, the Hebrew word to Noto Sans Hebrew, following the theme family fallback order. No system font, no .notdef.

states.name: Typographic anchors

case.text: 21 · Anchors: cap, baseline, x-height across sizes · recorded

states.notes: Recorded (PLAN 0.5): across 112, 64 and 28 cu, the first row's cap tops share one line (the cell top, 210 cu); the second row's baselines share one line (the cell bottom, 642 cu); the tops of the third row's x-height letters (a x e) share one line (780 cu). Every specimen is one line, and the rows do not touch. Cap height and x-height come from each font's OS/2 table, not glyph bounds.

states.name: Bar chart, before its values

case.text: 22 · Bar chart: values in, then the next quarter · recorded

states.notes: The slide before its chart: only the case label. The next state builds the chart in.

states.name: Bar chart: values animate in
states.notes: Pass at rest: six bars keyed by label in the theme's first categorical color, square on a hairline baseline and rounded at the top; value labels above, quarter labels below, tabular lining figures. Pass in the transition from `chart-intro` (420 ms): every bar grows from the baseline while its label rides its top, counts up from 0, and fades in; the quarter labels and the baseline fade in. t = 0 is `chart-intro` at rest and t = 420 ms this state at rest, exactly.

states.name: Next quarter

bars.alt: Six bars from Q2 2025 to Q3 2026; the last is the tallest.

states.notes: Pass: the next quarter arrives and the window scrolls. Matched by label, 2025-Q2 to 2026-Q2 slide one band left and rescale to the new maximum (38). 2025-Q1 rides out with 2025-Q2 under the chart's left edge, shrinking onto the baseline as its label counts down to 0 and fades; 2026-Q3 rides in with 2026-Q2 from past the right edge, growing from the baseline as its label counts up to 38. Nothing overlaps; the chart clips at its sides only. Frames sample the two layouts and lay nothing out (gate 0 criterion 3).

states.name: Mesh background
states.notes: Pass: a seeded mesh gradient fills the canvas under the case label, the four `torture` colors blending smoothly in Oklab with fine grain, at 0.84 s on the global timeline; every painter draws it within SPEC §13.5 (gate 0 criterion 4).

states.name: Shapes
states.notes: Pass: a rounded panel with a hairline, a pill, a ring, an arrow with its head, a rule and a dashed rule, a triangle, a star fitted from SVG path data, and an oval, each in its grid cell in theme colors; every painter draws them alike.

states.name: Images
states.notes: Pass: the test card (assets/test-card.png, 480 x 240) seven ways, each in its grid cell. Top row: cover keeps the middle bands and the disc; cover with focal [0, 0.5] keeps the left bands and the yellow corner mark; contain shows all four corner marks, centered; fill with crop [0.25, 0, 0.5, 1] stretches the middle four bands. Bottom row: cover with focal [0.5, 1] and radius.4 keeps the bottom, the half-transparent strip blending with the page, corners rounded; contain in a narrow box rounds the drawn image's corners, not the box's; crop [0, 0, 0.125, 0.125] magnifies the checkerboard about ten times, bilinear. Every painter draws them alike (SPEC §13.5).

states.name: Containers
states.notes: Pass: rows 2-4, a row stack of three cards sharing its width, each a padded, rounded column stack whose figure and caption sit at its foot, the captions wrapping inside the card. Row 5, a row stack whose 72 cu figure and 40 cu label share one baseline on the row's bottom edge, and at its right end a group of a ring and a dot at 0.6 opacity. Rows 6-8, a grid container whose photo spans two rows of its wider column, its note and dot in the named areas beside it (the dot 48 cu, centered); and a framed card whose photo fills its padding with a pill and its label placed by rect. Every box comes from taffy, laid out once for the state.

states.name: Line alignment
states.notes: Pass: rows 2-3, a balanced paragraph whose lines are centered in the 12-column box, its opening quote inside the first line (centered text has no aligned edge, so nothing hangs). Rows 4-5, end-aligned lines flush with the right edge of column 12; the last line's period and closing ” hang past that edge (the role sets hangingPunctuation), with the s of this on it. Rows 6-8, a Hebrew paragraph broken by pretty (no fallback to greedy), every line starting at the right edge of column 12.

states.name: Case and measure
states.notes: Pass: row 2 in capitals, ß as SS; row 3 with each word's first letter capitalized, (Even) after a parenthesis, 3rd unchanged; row 4 in EB Garamond's own small capitals (smcp), none synthesized. Rows 5-8, a body paragraph held to 24 characters a line (24 × the advance of 0), balanced, each line centered across all 12 columns.

states.name: Fit policies
states.notes: Pass: rows 2-5, left, a headline too long for its box at 96, set at the largest size at which it keeps to its role's two lines (shrink, maxLines 2 from the theme, no smaller than 40); right, a one-word body text grown until it fills the box, here its width (grow, no larger than 400). Rows 6-8, a headline held to one line (maxLines 1) by shrinking until it fits across the 12 columns. Nothing overflows; each size comes from bisection between the text's bounds, the same on every platform.

states.name: Hyphenation
states.notes: Pass: the same paragraph three times in four-column boxes, English patterns. Left, pretty with hyphenation: words break between syllables, each hyphen drawn in the line's own font and counted in its width, and no line passes the column's right edge. Middle, pretty without: no word breaks. Right, greedy, end-aligned with hanging punctuation: lines flush with the right edge, the hyphens and the closing stop hanging past it.

states.name: Chart kinds: bars, stacks, lines, areas

case.text: 31 · Chart kinds: bars, stacks, lines, areas · recorded

states.notes: Pass: four charts over one long table of three products by quarter, each series in its categorical color in every chart. Grouped bars share each quarter, with a legend above and a value axis whose gridlines fall on round dollars. Stacked bars pile Core, Cloud, and Edge with each stack's total above it. Lines run through each series' points, their end labels nudged apart where they would touch. Areas stack in series order. No transition: a cut.

states.name: Chart kinds: the next quarter

case.text: 32 · Chart kinds: the next quarter · recorded

states.notes: Pass in the transition (frame @0.5): the window advances a quarter by key in all four charts. Q1 rides out under the left edge and Q5 rides in from the right; bars and stacks grow from and shrink to the baseline as they go, stacks never gap, and a line's or an area's new point slides in off its end, level with where the line ended.

states.name: Chart kinds: scatter, dots, donut, table

case.text: 33 · Chart kinds: scatter, dots, donut, table · recorded

states.notes: Pass: a scatter on round axes both ways, each dot's area by its seats; a dot plot with its legend below; a donut whose labels sit outside each slice, legend at the right; and a table sorted by revenue, numbers in tabular figures at their columns' ends, the region column taking the room to spare.

states.name: Chart kinds: data moves by key

case.text: 34 · Chart kinds: data moves by key · recorded

states.notes: Pass in the transition (frame @0.5): scatter dots move to their new places by name; Partners closes as Social opens in the donut, the ring whole throughout, and every slice keeps its color; the table re-sorts by growth, rows moving to where they now stand.

states.name: Bars that regroup
states.notes: Pass: grouped bars, three products to a quarter, value labels over each bar.

states.name: Bars that regroup: stacked
states.notes: Pass in the transition (frames @0.25 and @0.75): the bars regroup in two stages, as d3's do. First the heights: each bar rises to its place in its quarter's stack while still side by side. Then the widths: the bars slide together into one stack. Each stack's total counts up over its top segment.

states.name: Chart annotations
states.notes: Pass: left, grouped bars with a band behind Q3 and Q4 (the accent at 0.12, under the gridlines) reading “Launch” inside its top-left corner, a target rule across the plot at $20 in the accent with “Target” over its start, a callout whose leader rises from over Q4 Cloud's bar to “Record”, and gridlines between the quarters' bands; the legend starts with its title, “Product”, on the entries' baseline. Right, lines with only Cloud at full strength: Core and Edge, their end labels, and their legend entries dim to 0.3; a callout over Cloud's Q3 point reads “Cloud doubles”; gridlines run through each quarter; the legend stands at the right under its title.

states.name: Chart annotations: they move
states.notes: Pass in the transition (frame @0.5): each annotation moves to where this state puts it. The band narrows to Q4 alone, the target rule rises to $25 as the value axis widens to reach it, and the callout slides from Cloud's bar to Core's. On the right, Cloud dims as Core comes up, their end labels and legend entries with them, and the callout moves from Cloud's Q3 point to Core's Q4 point while its text cross-fades from “Cloud doubles” to “Core leads”.

states.name: Shaders and gradient paints
states.notes: Pass: top row, three gradient shaders in the torture palette, blended in Oklab: a linear one at 120° with light grain, a radial one from left of center out past the corners, and a conic one turning 12° a second from 30° (shown at its time on the global timeline), its last color meeting its first without a seam. Middle row: soft noise from the theme preset `noise-soft`, forty seeded particles drifting over the surface, and film grain in ink and paper over an accent rect. Bottom row, gradient paints on shapes: a rounded rect from accent to ink left to right, an ellipse lit from its upper left, and a rounded rect whose 8 cu stroke turns from accent through ink and back.

states.name: Motion

case.text: 40 · Motion on the cue clock · recorded

states.notes: Pass: the state cuts in, and its motions run on its clock. The headline rises word by word, 60 ms apart. From 200 ms the three cards rise one after another, 120 ms apart, each card's caption riding with its card. From 400 ms the four bars grow from the baseline on the snappy spring, 80 ms apart, the axis fading in with the first. At 900 ms the dot pulses once on the gentle spring, to 1.25 times its size and back. At rest, everything stands where the layout puts it.

states.name: Morphs: the state before
states.notes: Pass: the state the next case morphs from, at rest. A headline, "Revenue grew this quarter". Row 4-6: an accent triangle standing on its base; an accent five-point star with a thin ink outline; a gradient from the torture palette running top to bottom; and a group at 0.6 opacity of an accent disc and an ink disc that overlap, composited as one layer, so where they overlap only the ink disc shows, at 0.6. Rows 7-8, right: "A record quarter" in ink.

states.name: Morphs
states.notes: Pass: the 420 ms transition from the case before, its frames at 0.25, 0.5, and 0.75 of the cue. "Revenue grew" and "this quarter" move apart as "fast" fades in between them; the case label's shared words move the same way. The triangle turns over point by point into an ink one standing on its tip, its fill mixing in Oklab. The star's points swell into a rounder star, vertex by vertex. The gradient turns from top-to-bottom to left-to-right and takes on grain, its uniforms moving, not cross-fading. The group fades to 0.3 as one layer while the ink disc slides left, further over the accent one, the accent never showing through it. The arrow draws on over 800 ms from its tail, its head riding the tip. After the transition, "A record quarter" warms to the accent and back over 400 ms. At rest, everything stands where the layout puts it.

states.name: Formats: 16:9 and 9:16
states.notes: Pass: on the deck's 1920 × 1080 canvas, the claim stands left of the bar chart, each in half of the grid. In 9:16 (`render --format 9:16`, frame `formats~9x16`) the deck lays out again on a 1080 × 1920 canvas: the theme's 9:16 grid narrows the side margins to 64 cu, the specimen layout's `left` and `right` slots stack, the claim wraps across the full width on rows 2-4, and the chart takes the full width on rows 5-8. Nothing in the deck changes.
